title: The pieces roster
description: Every piece the kits ship, once. scripts/pieces.json carries one entry per piece; `pnpm check:parity` and `pnpm registry:generate` read it, so a field's shape here is the contract those tools rely on.

storyId.description: A Storybook story id: sanitized title, two dashes, sanitized story name (e.g. custom-rings--hero).

anchor.description: The piece's anchor in the astro-app /kit gallery, without the piece- prefix.

svelteFile.description: The piece's file under packages/brand-svelte/src/lib; a .stories.svelte file for pieces that are patterns.

astroFile.description: The piece's file under packages/brand-astro/src, when it differs from svelteFile with .astro for .svelte (stock Starwind components are PascalCase).

name.description: The piece's name, unique across the roster.

lab.description: The story id that shows the piece in the lab's Storybook, or null when it has no story of its own (internal helpers, parts always shown inside another piece).

svelte.description: The story id that shows the piece in the Svelte kit's Storybook, or null when it has no story of its own.

astro.description: The piece's anchor in the astro-app /kit gallery.

svelteFile.description: The piece's file in the Svelte kit, or "not yet" while its plan is still in progress (the piece doesn't exist at all yet).

svelteItem.description: The piece's registry item name in the Svelte registry.

astroItem.description: The piece's registry item name in the Astro registry.

astroFile.description: The piece's file in the Astro kit, when it isn't svelteFile with .astro for .svelte.
